title: Bohemian Rhapsody
description: 《Bohemian Rhapsody》描寫一個人在罪疚、恐懼與命運之間掙扎的內心世界。歌中的主角像是在面對自己犯下的錯誤，既害怕承擔後果，又渴望逃離現實。他向母親告別，表達後悔與對死亡的恐懼，之後歌曲進入如歌劇般混亂而戲劇性的段落，象徵內心的審判、衝突與反抗。到了最後，他似乎逐漸放下掙扎，以「一切都不再重要」的態度接受命運。最終，《Bohemian Rhapsody》傳達的是對罪疚、自由、死亡與人生無常的深刻思考：人在面對無法改變的過去時，可能經歷恐懼、反抗與痛苦，最後只能學會接受自己的選擇與命運。

vocabulary.meaning: 幻想；想像出來、不是真實的事物
vocabulary.usage: 談夢想、故事或不可能發生的事情時，可以用 fantasy。
options: My fantasy is a robot that attends meetings for me.
I charge my fantasy for an hour to make it work.
Please fantasy the door before you leave.
My train ticket is fantasy because it costs eight dollars.
vocabulary.explanation: fantasy 指想像中的情景；這裡想由機械人代開會。
optionExplanations: fantasy 指想像中的情景；這裡想由機械人代開會。
fantasy 指幻想，無法像電器一樣充電。
錯誤：fantasy 通常是名詞，不能直接當「關門」的動詞。
票價與幻想沒有直接關係；這裡也需要不同的句子結構。

vocabulary.usage: 想說從危險、困難的地方或情況離開時，可以用 escape from。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Escape from」？
options: I escape from my exam by writing my name on it.
We escaped from the lift, still holding our party balloons.
She escaped from her haircut by sitting in the salon chair.
We escaped from our family photo by standing in the middle.
vocabulary.explanation: escape from 表示逃離被困的地方。
optionExplanations: 寫名字是在開始作答，不能表達逃離考試。
escape from 表示逃離被困的地方。
坐上理髮椅通常是在準備剪髮，無法支持逃離的意思。
站在合照中間是在參與，與逃離的意思相反。

vocabulary.usage: 要人抬頭看天空，或在字典、網路找資訊時，可以用 look up。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Look up」？
options: I looked up the lift button to travel to floor ten.
He looks up his guitar to make the strings tighter.
She looked up her bike to ride to school.
Look up! There is a beautiful bird above us.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：鳥在頭上，look up 表示「抬頭看」。
optionExplanations: 搭電梯要按按鈕；look up 無法代替 press。
調整琴弦應用 tune；look up 無法表達調音。
錯誤：騎腳踏車用 ride，不能用 look up。
正確：鳥在頭上，look up 表示「抬頭看」。

vocabulary.usage: 要說一個人、一件事對某人重要時，可以用 matter to。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Matter to」？
options: My phone matters to the timetable because it feels lonely.
Please matter to my bag before lunch.
My family matters to me more than my new phone.
This chair matters to blue at nine.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示家人對我而言比新手機更重要。
optionExplanations: timetable 沒有感受，這句無法表達對某人重要。
錯誤：matter to 不是叫人對袋子做的動作。
正確：表示家人對我而言比新手機更重要。
錯誤：blue 是顏色，句子沒有說清楚「對誰重要」。

vocabulary.usage: 想說自己原本打算做什麼，或不是故意做錯事時，可以用 mean to + 動詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Mean to」？
options: I mean to a new job at the bank.
I didn't mean to wake the baby. I'm sorry.
She means to happy every Sunday.
We mean to the school bus yesterday.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：mean to wake 表示「有意叫醒」，否定句是「不是故意的」。
optionExplanations: mean to 後面要接動詞原形，例如 apply for。
正確：mean to wake 表示「有意叫醒」，否定句是「不是故意的」。
錯誤：happy 是形容詞，要說 means to be happy。
錯誤：to 後面少了動詞，且 yesterday 要配合過去式。

vocabulary.usage: 東西壞了或不需要了，要把它丟掉時，可以用 throw away。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Throw away」？
options: Dad threw away the old newspaper because nobody needed it.
I threw away the invitation by reading every word.
She threw away the sun so it became night.
We throw away to the library after school.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：把不用的舊報紙丟掉，正是 throw away。
optionExplanations: 正確：把不用的舊報紙丟掉，正是 throw away。
閱讀請帖與丟棄請帖是不同動作。
錯誤：太陽不是人可以拿來丟掉的物品。
錯誤：去圖書館應說 go to the library。

vocabulary.usage: 事情還沒結束、想請別人繼續時，可以用 carry on，也可以說 carry on + -ing。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Carry on」？
options: I carried on my report in the printer for an hour.
The teacher carried on the window to make it blue.
The music stopped, but we carried on dancing.
Carry on the train with a minute of music.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：音樂停了，但我們繼續跳舞。
optionExplanations: 列印報告應用 printed；carry on 無法這樣接報告與印表機。
錯誤：carry on 不能表示「油漆窗戶」。
正確：音樂停了，但我們繼續跳舞。
若要叫人上車，應用 get on；這個搭配不成立。

vocabulary.usage: 要說某個人看起來或做起事來「好像……一樣」時，可以用 as if + 子句。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「As if」？
options: He talks as if he knows everything.
She bought an as if at the shop.
My uncle is as if because he likes films.
I put as if under my bed.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：表示他說話的樣子彷彿什麼都知道。
optionExplanations: 正確：表示他說話的樣子彷彿什麼都知道。
錯誤：as if 不是名詞，不能當作一件商品。
as if 後面缺少要比較的情況，整句沒有完整意思。
錯誤：as if 是連接語，不是可以放在床下的東西。

vocabulary.usage: 出門時忘記帶東西，或把某個人／東西留在後面時，可以用 leave behind。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Leave behind」？
options: My pencil left behind the answer in my book.
She left behind to sing a song at lunch.
I left behind my ticket by showing it to the guard.
I left my map behind. Our guide looked worried.
vocabulary.explanation: leave behind 指把東西遺留在原處。
optionExplanations: 錯誤：鉛筆不會主動把答案留下，這裡搭配不自然。
錯誤：leave behind 應接被留下的對象，不能直接接 to sing。
出示車票沒有表示把車票遺留在某處。
leave behind 指把東西遺留在原處。

vocabulary.usage: 想說不阻止某人離開，或放下某段關係時，可以用 let + 人 + go。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「Let someone go」？
options: The teacher let my timetable go to sleep.
The teacher let us go home early after the test.
I let my bank account go to the theatre alone.
She let the weather go because it was raining.
vocabulary.explanation: 正確：老師讓我們考完試提早回家。
optionExplanations: timetable 沒有睡覺的能力，無法作這個動作的對象。
正確：老師讓我們考完試提早回家。
銀行帳戶無法獨自去劇院，這裡用法不合。
錯誤：人不能像放人離開那樣讓天氣「走」。

questions.meaning: 同情、憐憫；對他人困境的關懷
questions.usage: 得知別人失去親友、受挫或遭遇不幸時，可表達 sympathy。
questions.prompt: 哪一句最自然地使用「sympathy」並符合上面的意思？
options: She showed sympathy by ignoring his request for help.
She showed sympathy by mocking his broken bicycle.
She showed sympathy by listening to his worries.
She showed sympathy by laughing at his bad news.
optionExplanations: 錯誤。故意不理會求助不能當成表達同情。

questions.explanation: 正確。願意耐心聆聽對方的煩惱，是表達同理與關懷。

questions.usage: 對眼前的人、地方或事物不確定，想請對方確認時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Is this the right room? Please give me two bananas.
Is this the right room? I already know we are in the wrong building.
Is this the right room? The sign says Room 8, and our class is in Room 8.
Is this the right room? The room is a person who sings.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：要求香蕉沒有回答房間是否正確的問題。
錯誤：已確定在錯誤的大樓，這個確認問題與已知情況不合。
正確：門牌與課室資料一致，詢問是否找對房間很自然。
錯誤：把房間說成會唱歌的人，語意不合理。
questions.example: Is this the right room?
questions.explanation: 正確：門牌與課室資料一致，詢問是否找對房間很自然。

questions.word: past participle phrase: caught in + noun
questions.meaning: 用過去分詞片語簡潔表示主詞處於某種狀況。
questions.usage: 描述人或物正陷入某個情況，並接著說反應或結果時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Caught in the rain, the sun was dry inside a box.
Caught in the rain, we ran into a café.
Caught in the rain, the rain was singing to us.
Caught in the rain, my shoes decided to become doctors.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：主詞與情境不一致，也沒有清楚表達被雨困住的人。
正確：we 是遇上雨的人，後面接著說他們如何避雨。
錯誤：句首片語應合理指向主句主詞，這裡變成「雨」被雨困住。
錯誤：鞋子成為醫生與遇上下雨的情況無關。
questions.example: Caught in the rain, we ran inside.
questions.explanation: 正確：we 是遇上雨的人，後面接著說他們如何避雨。

questions.meaning: 用 no 否定一種可能或事物，後面的 from 說明它所對應的情況。
questions.usage: 強調某件事沒有逃離、離開或擺脫的可能時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: There is no escape from this room; the door is open and we can leave.
There is no escape from this room because my tea is too sweet.
There is no escape from my shoes because my shoes are happy.
There is no escape from the maze until we find the exit.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：門開著又可以離開，與 no escape 矛盾。
錯誤：茶太甜沒有說明為何不能離開房間。
錯誤：鞋子開心不是無法逃離的合理原因。
正確：找到出口之前不能離開迷宮，符合 no escape from。
questions.example: There is no way out of this room.
questions.explanation: 正確：找到出口之前不能離開迷宮，符合 no escape from。

questions.meaning: 直接請求、指示或命令別人做事。
questions.usage: 需要清楚告訴別人下一步要做甚麼時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Open the box carefully. This will make the box stay closed.
Open the box carefully. It has a glass cup inside.
Open the box carefully. The box is a cloud in the sky.
Open the box carefully. We need to turn on the radio instead.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：打開盒子不會使盒子保持關閉。
正確：盒內有玻璃杯，提醒小心打開是合理指示。
錯誤：雲不是這裏可以打開的盒子。
錯誤：要開收音機卻叫人開盒子，指示與目的不符。
questions.example: Open the box carefully.
questions.explanation: 正確：盒內有玻璃杯，提醒小心打開是合理指示。

questions.meaning: 把兩個相關動作連在一起，按次序或同時進行。
questions.usage: 想用一句簡短的話指示兩個相連動作時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Turn on the light and read the sign; nobody has written any sign.
Turn on the light and read the sign; the sign is a cake we must eat.
Turn on the light and read the sign; it is too dark to see now.
Turn on the light and read the sign; we want the room to become darker.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：既然沒有告示，就不能讀出那張告示的內容。
錯誤：把告示說成要吃的蛋糕，第二個動作不合理。
正確：先開燈，才能更清楚閱讀告示，兩個動作有關連。
錯誤：開燈通常令房間變亮，與想變暗的目的相反。
questions.cue: Look up to the skies and see
questions.example: Look up and watch the birds.
questions.explanation: 正確：先開燈，才能更清楚閱讀告示，兩個動作有關連。

questions.meaning: 強調完全不需要某種東西；語氣比 do not need any 更直接。
questions.usage: 想有力地表達自己不需要幫助、物品或其他事物時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: I need no water, so please give me three glasses because I am very thirsty.
I need no food; I have not eaten for days and must eat now.
I need no ticket; the guard says everyone must show a ticket.
I need no help; I have already finished the job myself.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：一邊說不需要水，一邊因口渴要求三杯水，意思衝突。
錯誤：後面強調急需進食，與 need no food 矛盾。
錯誤：明知所有人都要出示票，卻說不需要票，缺乏合理根據。
正確：工作已自己完成，表示不需要幫忙很合理。
questions.example: I need no help; I can carry it.
questions.explanation: 正確：工作已自己完成，表示不需要幫忙很合理。

questions.meaning: 解釋某件事發生的原因。
questions.usage: 先交代決定或結果，再說明原因時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: The shop is closed because the shop is not open.
I slept early because I wanted to stay awake all night.
The train is late because my hat is yellow.
I bought a map because I wanted to know the way.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：後半句只重複「關門」的意思，沒有提供真正原因。
錯誤：提早睡與整晚保持清醒的目的相反。
錯誤：帽子的顏色無法合理解釋火車遲到。
正確：想知道路線，所以買地圖，原因與行為吻合。
questions.cue: Because I’m easy come, easy go
questions.example: I stayed home because I felt sick.
questions.explanation: 正確：想知道路線，所以買地圖，原因與行為吻合。

questions.meaning: 表示不論採取哪一種方式或出現哪一種情況，主句仍成立。
questions.usage: 想表示不受不同選擇或方式影響時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Any way you make the sandwich, I can eat it; I like all kinds.
Any way you make the sandwich, I will only eat it if you use red bread.
Any way you make the sandwich, the sandwich will drive a train.
Any way you make the sandwich, I cannot eat any kind of sandwich.
optionExplanations: 正確：不論三明治怎樣做都願意吃，表達方式不影響結果。
錯誤：只接受一種麵包，與 any way 的廣泛接受不一致。
錯誤：三明治開火車並不是合理結果。
錯誤：完全不能吃任何三明治，與前面容許各種做法的語境不吻合。
questions.example: Any way you choose, I will help.
questions.explanation: 正確：不論三明治怎樣做都願意吃，表達方式不影響結果。

questions.meaning: 表示某件事對某人重要或有影響。
questions.usage: 說明自己重視某人的選擇、意見或感受時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Your answer matters to me, so I will eat the answer with rice.
Your answer matters to me, so I will never listen to it and do not care.
Your answer matters to me, so I will listen carefully.
Your answer matters to me because my socks are green.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：答案不是可用飯吃掉的物品。
錯誤：一面說重要，一面完全不在乎，前後衝突。
正確：願意仔細聽答案，顯示它對說話者很重要。
錯誤：襪子顏色沒有說明答案的重要性。
questions.example: Your answer matters to me.
questions.explanation: 正確：願意仔細聽答案，顯示它對說話者很重要。

questions.meaning: 利用過去式敘述已發生的動作，並指出後來結果。
questions.usage: 講故事或解釋某件事如何造成另一件事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: I dropped the cake, and the floor ate it politely.
I dropped the cake yesterday, and it will be dropped yesterday tomorrow.
I dropped the cake, and it flew up because of gravity.
I dropped the cake, and it fell onto the floor.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：地板不會像人一樣有禮貌地吃蛋糕。
錯誤：昨天與明天的時間說法互相衝突。
錯誤：普通情況下，重力不會使蛋糕向上飛。
正確：蛋糕掉落後到地上，動作與結果順序合理。
questions.cue: Pulled my trigger, now he’s dead
questions.example: I dropped the cup, and it broke.
questions.explanation: 正確：蛋糕掉落後到地上，動作與結果順序合理。

questions.meaning: 表示一件事在另一個過去時刻之前已經發生。
questions.usage: 要讓學生清楚分辨兩件過去事情的先後時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: The film had started before we arrived, but it did not start until after we left.
The film had started before we arrived because our popcorn was blue.
The film had started before we arrived, so we missed the first scene.
The film had started before we arrived, so we arrived before it started.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：後面說電影在我們離開之後才開始，時間順序衝突。
錯誤：爆谷顏色不會造成電影提早開始。
正確：電影先開始，我們後到，因此錯過開頭。
錯誤：後半句反過來說我們先到，與 had started before 矛盾。
questions.example: The film had started before we arrived.
questions.explanation: 正確：電影先開始，我們後到，因此錯過開頭。

questions.meaning: 口語中帶出做了某件事後的驚訝、懊惱或不滿。
questions.usage: 發現自己或別人又犯錯，想帶點情緒地說出時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: I have gone and lost my keys again, so I cannot open the door.
I have gone and lost my keys again, so I am holding them in my hand right now and have never lost them.
I have gone and lost my keys again because the keys are singing opera.
I have gone and lost my keys again, so I used them to open the door five minutes ago and have kept them safe.
optionExplanations: 正確：又弄丟鑰匙，導致無法開門，符合懊惱語氣。
錯誤：同時說從未丟過而且正拿著鑰匙，與失去鑰匙衝突。
錯誤：鑰匙唱歌劇不合理，也不能解釋遺失。
錯誤：已妥善保管鑰匙，與再次弄丟不一致。
questions.cue: I’ve gone and thrown it all away
questions.example: I have gone and lost my keys again.
questions.explanation: 正確：又弄丟鑰匙，導致無法開門，符合懊惱語氣。

questions.word: did not mean to + base verb
questions.meaning: 表示做了某事，但不是故意要這樣做。
questions.usage: 道歉或澄清不是有意造成麻煩時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: I did not mean to wake you. I dropped a book by mistake.
I did not mean to wake you. The lamp decided to become a singer.
I did not mean to wake you. You have been awake all day and I never made a sound.
I did not mean to wake you. I played loud music because I wanted you to wake up.
optionExplanations: 正確：不小心掉書吵醒人，說不是故意的很合適。
錯誤：燈變歌手是無關的荒謬解釋。
錯誤：對方一直醒著，也沒有被吵醒，這個道歉缺少對應事件。
錯誤：明確想吵醒對方，不能同時說自己無意如此。
questions.cue: Didn’t mean to make you cry
questions.example: I did not mean to break the cup.
questions.explanation: 正確：不小心掉書吵醒人，說不是故意的很合適。

questions.meaning: 表示使某人產生某種反應或做某件事。
questions.usage: 解釋甚麼讓人笑、哭、擔心或改變行為時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: The funny picture made us to laugh all day.
The funny picture made the wall laugh and ask for tea.
The funny picture made us laugh, so none of us laughed or smiled.
The funny picture made us laugh, and we all smiled.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：make 後面應接 laugh，不能加 to。
錯誤：牆壁無法像人一樣發笑和點茶。
錯誤：後面否定所有人發笑，與 made us laugh 衝突。
正確：有趣的圖片引發大家發笑，符合 make + 人 + 原形動詞。
questions.example: The joke made us laugh.
questions.explanation: 正確：有趣的圖片引發大家發笑，符合 make + 人 + 原形動詞。

questions.meaning: 先設定可能出現的情況，再給出相應指示。
questions.usage: 給別人應對不同情況的建議或安排時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: If the cake is ready, take it out of the oven.
If the cake is ready, please ask the table to sing.
If the cake is ready, put it back in for ten more hours because it is already burned.
If the cake is ready yesterday, we will bake it yesterday tomorrow.
optionExplanations: 正確：蛋糕烤好後拿出來，條件與指示合理。
錯誤：桌子唱歌與蛋糕是否烤好無關。
錯誤：蛋糕已燒焦卻還要烤十小時，不合理。
錯誤：時態與時間表達混亂。
questions.cue: If I’m not back again this time tomorrow

pattern.text: 現在式條件，+  原形動詞

questions.example: If you feel cold, close the window.
questions.explanation: 正確：蛋糕烤好後拿出來，條件與指示合理。

questions.meaning: 把某個表現與假想情況作比較，意為「彷彿……」。
questions.usage: 描述人的行為看起來像在另一種情況中時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: He walked as if the window, and he opened a chair.
He walked as if he were a king, even though he was in a school play.
He walked as if he were asleep, but he did not move at all and was already sleeping.
He walked as if he is a bus ticket, because the ticket had a hat.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：as if 後缺少完整可理解的比較情況。
正確：舞台演員扮國王，舉止彷彿真的是國王。
錯誤：原本就在睡覺且沒有走動，無法描述走路的樣子。
錯誤：把人比成戴帽子的車票，沒有合理情境。
questions.example: She danced as if nobody was watching.
questions.explanation: 正確：舞台演員扮國王，舉止彷彿真的是國王。

questions.meaning: 表達某個情況到現在已經發生或出現。
questions.usage: 宣布等待的時刻終於來臨，或已有明確結果時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: The time has come to start the show; the show ended yesterday and nobody is here now.
The time has come to start the show; we will start it last year.
The time has come to start the show; the audience is ready.
The time has come to start the show because my bicycle is eating a cake.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：演出昨天已結束，現在無人，與宣布開始不符。
錯誤：未來會在去年開始，時間說法矛盾。
正確：觀眾準備好了，宣布開演時間到了很合適。
錯誤：腳踏車吃蛋糕不是開演時間到的原因。
questions.example: The time has come to start the show.
questions.explanation: 正確：觀眾準備好了，宣布開演時間到了很合適。

questions.meaning: 強調某個動作或狀態持續出現，令人注意。
questions.usage: 說明聲音、問題或活動一直發生時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: The old clock is making noise all the time, but it only made one sound last year and stopped forever.
The old clock is making noise all the time, but it has been silent for ten years.
The old clock is making noise all the time, even at night.
The old clock is making noise all the time because the clock is a sandwich.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：只響過一次便永久停止，不符合 all the time。
錯誤：已安靜十年，不能同時說一直發聲。
正確：連夜晚都有聲音，呼應 all the time 的持續性。
錯誤：時鐘是三明治並非合理原因。
questions.example: The old clock is making noise all the time.
questions.explanation: 正確：連夜晚都有聲音，呼應 all the time 的持續性。

questions.meaning: 表示迫切的需要或必須做的事；較口語。
questions.usage: 要強調眼前不能拖延的事情時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: We have got to leave now; the door will become a purple horse.
We have got to leave now; our train leaves in two minutes.
We have got to leave now; we are staying here until next month and have no reason to go.
We have got to leave now; we left last year and are not here anymore.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：門變成紫色馬並非合理原因。
正確：火車兩分鐘後開出，現在必須離開有充分理由。
錯誤：明言沒有需要離開，與 have got to 不符。
錯誤：既已在去年離開，就不能說此刻要從這裏走。
questions.example: We have got to leave now.
questions.explanation: 正確：火車兩分鐘後開出，現在必須離開有充分理由。

questions.meaning: 表示對已發生或未發生的過去感到遺憾，想像另一種過去。
questions.usage: 談自己希望過去不同，但現在無法改變時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: I wish I had brought my camera tomorrow; yesterday is next week.
I wish I had brought my camera yesterday; the view was lovely.
I wish I had brought my camera yesterday, and I did bring it yesterday, so I took many photos with it.
I wish I had brought my camera yesterday because cameras can cook soup.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：tomorrow 與 yesterday 的時間關係錯亂。
正確：昨天錯過拍美景的機會，適合用 wish + 過去完成式表遺憾。
錯誤：明說昨天已帶相機並拍照，與「希望當時有帶」的遺憾不符。
錯誤：相機煮湯不能解釋為何懊悔沒帶相機。
questions.cue: I sometimes wish I’d never been born at all
questions.example: I wish I had studied more yesterday.
questions.explanation: 正確：昨天錯過拍美景的機會，適合用 wish + 過去完成式表遺憾。

questions.meaning: 詢問對方是否願意或將會做某事。
questions.usage: 邀請或請求對方參加某項活動時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Will you join our game? The game is a banana that wants to sleep.
Will you join our game? You are already playing it, and the game ended yesterday.
Will you join our game? I need you to paint my shoes instead, not play.
Will you join our game? We need one more player.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：把遊戲描述成想睡覺的香蕉，情境不合理。
錯誤：對方已加入且遊戲已結束，邀請不符合情境。
錯誤：真正希望對方做的是油漆鞋子，而不是參加遊戲。
正確：遊戲缺一名玩家，邀請對方加入合理。
questions.example: Will you join our team?
questions.explanation: 正確：遊戲缺一名玩家，邀請對方加入合理。

questions.meaning: 表示一個人也沒有；在現在簡單式中動詞通常用單數。
questions.usage: 強調群體中沒有任何人做某事或知道某事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Nobody knows the answer yet because the answer is a singing pillow.
Nobody knows the answer yet; three students already told me the correct answer.
Nobody know the answer yet; every student is still guessing.
Nobody knows the answer yet; every student is still guessing.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：會唱歌的枕頭不能合理解釋資訊狀態。
錯誤：已有學生說出正確答案，與 nobody knows 矛盾。
錯誤：nobody 在一般現在式通常接 knows，而不是 know。
正確：每位學生都還在猜，表示沒有人知道答案。
questions.example: Nobody knows the answer yet.
questions.explanation: 正確：每位學生都還在猜，表示沒有人知道答案。

questions.meaning: 表示允許或讓某人做某事，動詞前不加 to。
questions.usage: 說准許、放行或要求別人不要阻止某個動作時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Let the children to choose a song; it is their party.
Let the children choose a song, but do not allow them to choose anything.
Let the children choose a song; it is their party.
Let the children choose a song; the children are wooden chairs.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：let 後面接原形 choose，不加 to。
錯誤：一邊允許選擇，一邊完全禁止選擇，前後矛盾。
正確：派對屬於孩子，讓他們選歌合理。
錯誤：把孩子說成木椅，沒有合理情境。
questions.example: Let the children choose a song.
questions.explanation: 正確：派對屬於孩子，讓他們選歌合理。

questions.meaning: 對未來行動作出堅定否定或拒絕。
questions.usage: 想清楚表明自己將不會做某件事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: I will not forget your birthday, so I have never known what a birthday is.
I will not forget your birthday; I have written it on my calendar.
I will not forget your birthday because the calendar is a talking fish.
I will not forget your birthday; I plan to forget it on purpose.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：完全不知道生日是甚麼，與這個承諾不合。
正確：把生日記在日曆上，支持不會忘記的決定。
錯誤：日曆是會說話的魚並非合理解釋。
錯誤：計劃故意忘記，與 will not forget 相反。
questions.cue: we will not let you go
questions.example: I will not forget your birthday.
questions.explanation: 正確：把生日記在日曆上，支持不會忘記的決定。

questions.meaning: 表示某個東西處於已被安排、準備或處理好的狀態。
questions.usage: 說已經請人處理、安排好某物，或已確保結果時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: I have my bags packed; we can leave for the airport now.
I have my bags packed because the bags can dance on their own.
I have my bags packed, so I must begin packing them for the first time next year.
I have my bags packed, but I have not put anything in them and they are all empty.
optionExplanations: 正確：行李已收好，現在可以出發，符合 have + object + 過去分詞。
錯誤：行李會跳舞不是完成打包的合理原因。
錯誤：既已收拾好，卻說明年才第一次開始打包，時間衝突。
錯誤：袋子完全未裝東西，與已收拾好的意思不一致。
questions.cue: has a devil put aside for me
questions.example: I have my bags packed for the trip.
questions.explanation: 正確：行李已收好，現在可以出發，符合 have + object + 過去分詞。

questions.word: So you think + subject + can + verb?
questions.meaning: 常帶質問、懷疑或不滿，挑戰對方的想法。
questions.usage: 對方過於自信或作出不合理假設，想反問時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: So you think you can win without practising? The match ended and you won yesterday.
So you think you can win without practising? The other team trains every day.
So you think you can win without practising? You have practised every day for a year.
So you think you can win without practising? Winning is a blue sandwich.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：比賽已贏，這個對未來能力的質疑缺乏對應情境。
正確：對手每天練習，反問從不練習的人能否獲勝，語氣合理。
錯誤：對方實際上天天練習，與 without practising 不一致。
錯誤：把勝利當成藍色三明治，沒有合理意思。
questions.cue: So you think you can stone me
questions.example: So you think you can win without practising?
questions.explanation: 正確：對手每天練習，反問從不練習的人能否獲勝，語氣合理。

questions.meaning: 一個情態動詞可同時支配兩個並列的動作。
questions.usage: 表達某人能夠做兩件相連的事時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: You can sit here and watch the show; this seat is free.
You can sit here and watch the show; the chair is on the moon and we are on Earth.
You can sit here and watch the show; the show is a potato sleeping in your bag.
You can sit here and watch the show; you must stand outside and cannot enter.
optionExplanations: 正確：座位空著，坐下觀看表演是合理安排。
錯誤：椅子在月球，與眼前可坐下的情況不符。
錯誤：把表演描述成睡著的馬鈴薯，語意不合理。
錯誤：不准入內就無法坐在這裏看表演。
questions.cue: can love me and leave me
questions.example: You can sit here and watch the show.
questions.explanation: 正確：座位空著，坐下觀看表演是合理安排。

questions.meaning: 表示把某人留下，讓他獨自面對某件事或完成某個動作。
questions.usage: 想表達不應把工作或難題全部留給某個人時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Do not leave me to carry all these chairs alone; there are twenty.
Do not leave me to carry all these chairs alone; the chairs are clouds that want coffee.
Do not leave me to carry all these chairs alone; I have a team of twenty people helping me now.
Do not leave me to carry all these chairs alone; you have already carried every chair and there are none left.
optionExplanations: 正確：椅子很多，請人不要留下自己一個人搬，很合理。
錯誤：椅子是喝咖啡的雲，情境荒謬。
錯誤：已有二十人幫忙，與 alone 的描述不一致。
錯誤：椅子已全部搬完，沒有剩餘工作可留下。
questions.example: Do not leave me to clean everything alone.
questions.explanation: 正確：椅子很多，請人不要留下自己一個人搬，很合理。

questions.meaning: 用 nothing 表示沒有任何事情，動詞按單數處理，副詞調整語氣。
questions.usage: 強調某個情況根本不重要或幾乎沒有變化時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Nothing really change in this village; the shops look the same.
Nothing really changes in this village; the shops look the same every year.
Nothing really changes in this village because villages are made of cheese.
Nothing really changes in this village; a new town is built here every month.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：nothing 在這個句型中通常接 changes，不是 change。
正確：多年來店舖沒變，支持 nothing really changes。
錯誤：村莊由芝士製成不是合理原因。
錯誤：每月建起新城鎮，與幾乎不變矛盾。
questions.example: Nothing really changes in this town.
questions.explanation: 正確：多年來店舖沒變，支持 nothing really changes。

questions.meaning: 表示不論是誰，都有能力或機會做某事。
questions.usage: 告訴大家某項活動沒有特定資格限制時。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確運用了以上句型，並符合所描述的情境？
options: Anyone can join the game; we welcome new players of all ages.
Anyone can join the game because the football is secretly a doctor.
Anyone can joins the game; we welcome everyone.
Anyone can join the game; only one named person is allowed to play.
optionExplanations: 正確：歡迎任何年齡的新玩家，符合 anyone can 的廣泛可能。
錯誤：足球變醫生與加入遊戲的資格無關。
錯誤：can 後應接原形 join，不是 joins。
錯誤：只有一位指定人士可以參加，與 anyone 相反。
questions.example: Anyone can join this club.
questions.explanation: 正確：歡迎任何年齡的新玩家，符合 anyone can 的廣泛可能。
